name: STACK
description:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.

_published_faq.name: How do I add STACK to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add STACK to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.stackct.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the STACK MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: STACK lists 19 MCP tools, including assign_tags_to_library_takeoff, copy_takeoffs_to_library, create_project, create_tags_in_library, create_takeoff, edit_takeoffs, find_estimates, find_library_takeoffs, find_project, find_takeoffs, get_company_options, and get_estimate_worksheet.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to STACK?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to STACK in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
STACK requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
STACK is developed by STACK Construction Technologies. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
